Title: [DECK]Darkling Trickery (and perhaps a silly question about another card)

Messages.Author: Sander Hanevelt
Messages.Body:
Deck Name: Darkling Trickery
Created By: Sander
Description:

Question: Can a single vampire that does a bleed action, play several
Seductions on different vampires ?

Darkling Trickery, because I think that Darkling is a perfect name for the
Kiasyd and Trickery fits well what Kiasyd bleeds do.

Lots of people around here are really big fans of second traditions, and
with the upcoming Camarilla set I expect to see lots more of second
tradition decks. So I decided to go ahead and add some extras against those
decks.

Suggestions are welcome as always.

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 22, Max: 35, Avg: 7.17)
----------------------------------------------
3 Marconius DOM MYT OBT pot 9, Kiasyd, Archbishop
2 Bartholomew AUS dom MYT NEC obt 8, Kiasyd
3 Julia Prima aus DOM myt OBT 7, Kiasyd
2 Kassiym Malikhair dom for MYT OBT 6, Kiasyd
2 Beatrice L'Angou aus dom MYT nec 5, Kiasyd

-------------------

2 Dominate

1 Hungry Coyote, The

2 Obtenebration

Action (11 cards)

Combo (6 cards)
6 Aura Absorption

This deck was last saved at 4:53:16 PM on 5/16/2002

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sander Hanevelt wrote:
> Question: Can a single vampire that does a bleed action, play several
> Seductions on different vampires ?

No. A given minion can only play 1 copy of a given modifier each action.

I would drop one Obtenebration master for an extra Minion Tap, as your pool

Are these in here only to give Julia Mytherceria?

> >

A little high on Conditionings, and a little low on Seductions, in my

some stealth for the necessary untaps and bleed defence.

> > 4 Obedience

How about Primal Instincts? I know, it costs 1 blood, but I think the card
is really overlooked to much, especially when using tricky strikes such as
the above.

> >
> > Equipment (4 cards)
> > 4 Leather Jacket

Definitely too high a number. You should be spending actions bleeding, not
equipping! Drop to two, I'd say - and pack some extra maneuvers for combat
defense, if you think you need more.

> >
> > Combo (6 cards)
> > 6 Aura Absorption

Very good card, that :)

All in all, a solid enough Kyasid deck, as yours usually are. Maybe not my
taste in combat defence (I'd use either more maneuvers and heavy strikes
(Earth Swords or Entombment, probably with Black Metamorphoses as well), or
more Obediences), but it could certainly work :).

Keep it up!

Patrick

Given the above answer, and your stated intent here, I would suggest
Call of the Hungry Dead, thus making a 'you can't block deck'. The way
I usually do it (if I am not expecting deflections et al.) is to tack
+1 stealth onto a bleed, seduce the obvious blocker, and then when
some other minion yanks out the intercept, CotHD them. Obviously, this
would be a shift of focus for your deck. On the plus side, most
players don't have too many princes (unless they incorporate princely
bload), and certainly not too early in the game, so you should get
through ok, and if not, at least pull out the 2nds at a high rate.

>

High average vampire capacity and no development accelerators (info,
zillah, dreams, etc.) - you will get hurt by weenies.

> Action (11 cards)

> 2 Graverobbing
> 1 Revelations
> 2 Sanguine Instruction

With such a high cap and slow development, you are only likely to see
2 vampires enter play, against aggressive opponents. Do you want to
spend an action on the SI?

> 6 Conditioning
> 4 Seduction

How do you expect this to perform against IG rush, aggropokey, and
Assamites? Against S:CE?

Good luck

Can't block is something different then what this deck does. It prevents the
second tradition decks and on the two tourneys I've been to at least 25%
uses second traditions to untap, so The Sleeping Mind is in place at a dutch
tournament table. And as en extra plus the same prince decks can't deflect
the bleeds I throw at them either if they normally rely on 2nd traditions
for untaps. And for some extra information I am planning to improve the deck
as soon as some of my trades come in.

That deck is basically a opportunity bleed deck, with very low stealth
(perhaps only the 2 points I can get from MYT)..for the remainder of my
turns I just stack up on a few permanent plusses to bleed. The layout will
be about this.

permanent bleed: 9 cards (Pulses and Retainers + Laptops)
digging in: 5-8 cards (Secure Haven, Chanjelin Wards)
permanent intercept: 2 cards (cheapest media)
intercept cards: 10 (preferably those that give maneuvers)
poolgain masters: 5-6
bleed defense: 10-15 cards
bleed chance increasers: 10
combat cards: whatever remains.

Agreed, the sleeping mind will shut down the 2nd trad bussiness blocks

slows down your prey, so it might be worth it. You do know a prince
that plays 2nd must try to block? i.e. try to block first, and not
deflect right away?

Improvements you make to the deck after you get trades - great. Show
'm to us then.



Which will only really work efficiently if you have Marconius or Julia
Prima (DOM), and Kassayim or Beatrice, since that will allow the new
vampire to show up in one turn after you add four influence. That, and
with only 6 Governs, you won't reliably see those.

It may be nit-picking, but I really think you could benefit from some
influence-boost - Info highway or Dreams of the Sphinx, even. And, if
you use your Governs for the speed boost, you only have 6
Conditionings for ousting power left. Not impossible, but I think
things could be significantly harder on your opponents.
